verify_content.description: Compute full SHA256 and exact line count for edit concurrency. False bounds positive-offset log reads to the requested window and reports unknown total_lines when more data exists.

offset.description: 1-based first line. Negative values count back from the end of the file.

line_offset.description: Alias of offset (Kimi native Read habit).

remote.name: remote_grep
remote.description: Requires manual MindIE activation in this session. Search remote files with rg-compatible semantics and a grep -E (POSIX ERE) fallback.

container.description: Existing Docker container name or ID on the SSH host. All tools operate inside it; results return a full ID for reuse without another name lookup. No provisioning or managed allocation.

runtime_env_file.description: Remote profile script sourced before commands when runtime_env is true.

alias.description: Name from the endpoint alias files.

output_mode.description: count = matching lines per file (Claude habit); count_matches = total matches per file (Kimi habit, rg --count-matches). They differ when one line holds several matches.

-i.description: Alias of case_insensitive (Claude Code / Kimi native Grep parameter).

context_lines.description: Show N lines before and after each match in content mode (rg/grep -C). Alias: -C.

before_context.description: Show N lines before each match in content mode (rg/grep -B). Alias: -B.

after_context.description: Show N lines after each match in content mode (rg/grep -A). Alias: -A.

line_numbers.description: Prefix content matches with line numbers. Default true. Alias: -n.

offset.description: Skip the first N result lines before applying the limit (pagination).

head_limit.description: Alias of limit (Kimi/Claude native Grep habit).

include_ignored.description: Also search hidden paths and paths ignored by .gitignore (rg --no-ignore --hidden). The grep fallback cannot evaluate .gitignore rules; there it only lifts the default hidden/.git directory excludes and reports a warning.

remote.name: remote_job_stdin
remote.description: Requires manual MindIE activation in this session. Write to a remote session's stdin (Codex write_stdin habit), with optional EOF and output polling.

container.description: Existing Docker container name or ID on the SSH host. All tools operate inside it; results return a full ID for reuse without another name lookup. No provisioning or managed allocation.

runtime_env_file.description: Remote profile script sourced before commands when runtime_env is true.

alias.description: Name from the endpoint alias files.

chars.description: Bytes to write to the job's stdin (Codex write_stdin habit). Omit or pass an empty string to only poll output. When stdin_buffer_full is reported, resend only the unwritten remainder: slice the original string at the returned written_chars character count (a byte count cannot slice a Unicode string).

eof.description: Close the job's stdin after writing chars. Programs waiting for end-of-input then finish. If the write was only partially accepted (stdin_buffer_full), the close is deferred: resend the unwritten remainder with eof=true.

yield_time_ms.description: After writing, keep polling up to this many milliseconds for output or completion before returning new output.

max_output_tokens.description: Cap the new output returned by this call, counted as four UTF-8 bytes/token across text and structured previews, shared by stdout/stderr; metadata separate. Skipped bytes are not lost: the read cursor only advances past what was returned.
